Alex H: Heads-up: candidate Priya K for Senior Infra. Hiring manager asking for base 230000 which exceeds band cap 200000. Also needs start 2025-06-02. Can we route an exception?
Maria R: Yep. Quick clarifying Qs: is that 230k base or OTE? equity? sign-on?
Alex H: 230k base, standard 10% bonus, equity 0.18% (4y), sign-on 15k. Current employer counter = 220k base.
Maria R: K. I'll create comp-exception request. Note: approvals required = Comp -> HRBP -> Finance per policy.
offer-bot: Comp-exception created: REQ-2025-1899. Routing: Lisa (Comp) -> Sophia (HRBP) -> Finance (CFO). SLA 48h.
Lisa (Comp): Reviewing. Please add Priya's current total comp, counteroffer screenshot, and a 90-day deliverables list. Why +30k over band?
Alex H: Business reason: critical infra ownership for KV cache migration and oncall gap. 90-day bullets: (1) KV cache perf improvements, (2) shard migration plan, (3) runbook updates + oncall triage.
Jamal M: Also need start date confirmation. Payroll: can we do 2025-06-02 if offer is signed by Friday?
Payroll Team: Ideally 5 business days for payroll setup and background clearance. If we get signed offer + I-9 & ID by EOD Friday and background returns in 2-3 days, June 2 is borderline but doable.
Maria R: Uploaded counteroffer screenshot, market comps, and 90-day plan to REQ-2025-1899. Tagging @Lisa (Comp).
Lisa (Comp): Thanks. Provisional: approve up to 225k. For 230k need CFO signoff + written ROI. Also confirm equity/timeframe.
Alex H: Equity confirmed 0.18% vesting 4y w/1y cliff. ROI: hiring avoids a 3-week rollout delay, reduces incident MTTR ~20% (will add numbers).
Sophia (HRBP): On HR side we want manager 90-day check-in and documented promo path. No relocation; remote US. Include that in packet.
Finance (CFO): I can approve up to 230k given tight market and operational risk. Legal FYI and payroll timeline OK?
offer-bot: REQ-2025-1899 status: Approved by Lisa (Comp) and Finance (CFO). Pending HRBP final ack.
Sophia (HRBP): Confirming HRBP approval. Make sure to add 90-day review milestone in offer.
Maria R: Finalizing offer letter: base 230000, bonus 10%, equity 0.18%, sign-on 15k, start 2025-06-02. Sending to candidate now.
Alex H: Please push ASAP. Priya is deciding between us and her counter.
Maria R: Sent verbal offer and follow-up email. Candidate asked for written offer and to confirm June 2 start.
Priya K (via Maria R): Verbal acceptance this morning, requested written offer to sign.
Payroll Team: Once signed offer uploaded, we will trigger background + payroll setup. Reminder: bank info + I-9 needed for first payroll.
Maria R: Signed offer uploaded to HRIS, background check initiated.
Payroll Team: Background cleared, payroll set for new hire. First paycheck cadence confirmed.
Alex H: Huge thanks everyone for quick routing. Welcome Priya! :raised_hands: :tada:
Maria R: Closing REQ-2025-1899 and saving documents to candidate file. If post-hire comp adjustments needed, open a new request.
Jamal M: Noted. See you on 2025-06-02, Priya.
Maria R: Closing thread.
